description: Use when a user asks how much to save each month for a goal, e.g. "how much do I need to save each month to have $50,000 in 5 years?" or "how much a month to reach $1 million in 30 years?". Monthly amount to save to reach a target in a number of years at a yearly rate, counting money already saved. Example: $1,000,000 in 30 years at 8% needs about $671 a month.
name: calculate_savings_goal
title: Savings goal calculator
